- The client must submit a photo/scan of an officially valid document (or Aadhaar e‑Sign) through Digiocker or another electronic/digital signature platform [1][36].  
- The PAN, name, photograph, address, mobile number and email ID are to be captured digitally and the same documents must be signed electronically [36].  
- The mobile number and email address provided by the client must be verified by a One‑Time‑Password (OTP) or any other verifiable mechanism [37][39].  
- Intermediaries must upload the verified mobile number and email address to the KRA system and ensure they belong to the client, not to employees or distributors [32][97].
